fullContent:
Pradara Chintamani Vati 
 Reference: Vaidya Chintamani 
 This is a very good ayurvedic medicine for leucorrhea and menorrhagia. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Dadima bark – Punica granatum 
 Babbula twak – Acacia arabica 
 Khadira – Acacia catechu 
 Twak – Cinnamomum zeylanicum 
 Amalaki – Emblica officinalis 
 Gairika – Red Ochre 
 Laksha – Laccifer Lacca 
 Ajashringi bhasma 
 Praval bhasma 
 
 How to Make? 
 Fine powder of above ingredients are mixed and semisolid mass is prepared, and pills are made. 
 Dosage 
 One tablet twice a day to be used with Ashokarishta. 
 Indications 
 
 Leucorrhoea 
 Menorrhagia 
 Cures pains during menstrual period and checks subsequent foul discharges from uterus. 
 Removes paleness of the complexion 
 Loss of appetite 
 Removes pains in back and in pelvis 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
